**One-Person Maximum Monthly SNAP Allotment (Oct 2026–Sept 2027)**

The federal maximum monthly SNAP allotment for a household of one in the contiguous states and DC is **$306**.

**Important:** This is the *maximum* benefit amount. Actual eligibility and the award your household receives are determined by your state SNAP agency based on your income, expenses, and household circumstances. Contact your state's SNAP office or apply through your local office to learn what you may qualify for.

Source: [USDA Food and Nutrition Service](https://www.fna.usda.gov/snap/recipient/eligibility)
